aspect:biology/molecular-aspect.collapses: The molecular aspect distinguishes RNA under a shared abundance kind.
aspect:biology/molecular-aspect.licenses: The explicit biology RNA facet on relative abundance.
aspect:biology/molecular-aspect.not_established: No protein abundance, absolute copy number, activity or common normalization is established.

bridge:biology/regulates.collapses: A gene-only literature verb collapses diverse regulatory mechanisms into a directed causal commitment.
bridge:biology/regulates.licenses: A narrower causal bridge to general/changes-under-intervention, with inherited edge eligibility for explicit claims.
bridge:biology/regulates.not_established: Directness, mechanism, tissue activity, causal estimands and support from observational PHF19 data are not established; retired affects and associates-with are not restored.

instantiation:biology/protein-transcript.collapses: Translation and transcript annotations remain distinct sorts.
instantiation:biology/protein-transcript.licenses: Typing their explicitly authored reference association.
instantiation:biology/protein-transcript.not_established: No unique sequence, expression or automatically related claim is established.

instantiation:biology/transcript-gene.collapses: The direct reference link uses Ensembl annotations rather than HGNC nomenclature.
instantiation:biology/transcript-gene.licenses: Typing a transcript and its annotated Ensembl gene.
instantiation:biology/transcript-gene.not_established: An HGNC crosswalk, reverse equivalence or gene-to-protein implication is not supplied.

measurement:biology/gene.collapses: Gene-bearing RNA abundance uses an explicitly checked identifier correspondence from Ensembl rows to HGNC.
measurement:biology/gene.licenses: A relative-abundance measurement on an HGNC gene when the procedure and mapping supply its particulars.
measurement:biology/gene.not_established: Mapping, aggregation and belief policy do not validate the assay, RNA-to-protein inference or independence; no ENSG or protein measurement is admitted.

sort:biology/ensembl-gene.collapses: An unversioned ENSG collapses gene-model versions within human Ensembl 115 on GRCh38.p14.
sort:biology/ensembl-gene.licenses: Naming the source annotation row and an explicit later correspondence to HGNC.
sort:biology/ensembl-gene.not_established: The historical matrix annotation release, HGNC identity and assay validity are not established.

sort:biology/gene.collapses: HGNC locus nomenclature collapses isoforms, proteoforms and gene-model diversity.
sort:biology/gene.licenses: Human HGNC locus terms from release 2025-09-05; replaces the retired v1 molecular-entity sort without succession.
sort:biology/gene.not_established: RNA isoforms, protein abundance, activity and a complete biological gene model are not identified.

sort:biology/molecular-aspect.collapses: The closed authored RNA facet abstracts over RNA species.
sort:biology/molecular-aspect.licenses: Distinguishing RNA interpretation on a relative-abundance observable.
sort:biology/molecular-aspect.not_established: Scheme syntax establishes no external ontology membership or protein interpretation.

sort:biology/protein.collapses: Versioned Ensembl translations over-split identical amino-acid sequences.
sort:biology/protein.licenses: Human transcript-associated translation annotation identity under Ensembl 115 on GRCh38.p14.
sort:biology/protein.not_established: A unique sequence, measured protein, modified proteoform, complex or UniProt equivalence is not established.

sort:biology/transcript.collapses: A versioned human Ensembl transcript is an annotation model.
sort:biology/transcript.licenses: Transcript annotation identity under Ensembl 115 on GRCh38.p14.
sort:biology/transcript.not_established: Actual expression, measured RNA and unversioned transcript membership are not established.

template:biology/transcribed-from.collapses: An annotation relation abstracts over transcription mechanisms.
template:biology/transcribed-from.not_established: Expression, abundance, universal coding, uniqueness, causation and coreference are not inferred.

template:biology/translated-from.collapses: The annotation relation abstracts over translation mechanisms.
template:biology/translated-from.not_established: Translation rate, protein quantity, expression and coreference are not inferred.
